title: Run Claude Code for Free
description:
Run Claude Code for free? Here's what everyone's talking about. 🤯

A new open-source project has gone viral after claiming it lets you use Claude Code without paying for Anthropic's API.

Instead of using paid models, it reroutes Claude Code to compatible free AI models through a small local proxy on your computer.

Here's how it works:
⚡ Install the tool with a single command.
⚡ Start the local proxy server.
⚡ Add a free API key (like NVIDIA's, if eligible).
⚡ Start coding using Claude Code with supported free models.

The setup reportedly takes just a couple of minutes, which is why the project has gained massive attention in the developer community.

As always, remember:
• Free APIs often come with rate limits.
• Performance may differ from Anthropic's official models.
• Review the project's security and privacy implications before using it.

Comment "CLAUDE" and I'll DM you the complete setup guide.

top_comments.text: Download claude code terminal natively then open your claude folder and in settings. Json file add environment variables for your model name , route (open-router link) , mention api key as blank ("") and finally add auth key which will be the api key from your router (it's free) and now you can use all free models through this router
